newsitem.title: USA: DLJ unit completes purchase of WMX unit.
newsitem.headline: DLJ unit completes purchase of WMX unit.

text.p: Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Inc said on Thursday that its DLJ Merchant Banking Partners LP has completed the acquisition of WMX Technologies Inc's Rust Scaffold Services Inc subsidiary.

Rust Scaffold has been renamed Brand Scaffold Services Inc. Its main business is to provide for the rental, erection and dismantlement of scaffolding to large industrial and commercial facilities. It is based in Oak Brook, Ill.

WMX announced on September 18 that its Rust International Inc subsidiary had agreed to sell its industrial scaffolding business to an investment group led by the company's management, DLJ Merchant Banking and Carlisle Enterprises LP.
